class.name: JRPGWeaponData
class.description: Database entry for a weapon. Weapons always go into equipment slot 1 and add their parameter changes and traits while equipped.

members.member: ID of the animation played when the holder attacks, or [code]0[/code] for none.
ID of the weapon type in [member JRPGTypesData.weapon_types]. Actors can equip it only if a trait allows that type.
